# HARDWARIO Documentation

> Technical documentation for HARDWARIO devices, firmware and HARDWARIO Cloud:
> hardware descriptions, configuration, firmware development, APIs and
> integration guides for LTE-M, NB-IoT and LoRaWAN. Published by HARDWARIO a.s.
> (Liberec, Czech Republic), which designs and manufactures the devices that
> bring industrial assets online. In English and Czech (/cs/, same paths).
> Welcomes AI crawlers; the full page list is in the sitemaps below.

## Devices and cloud

- [Documentation home](https://docs.hardwario.com/): entry point to the documentation of every device and service
- [CHESTER](https://docs.hardwario.com/chester/): reads sensors, meters and machines and reports over LTE-M, NB-IoT or LoRaWAN; catalog applications, extension modules and the firmware SDK
- [STICKER](https://docs.hardwario.com/sticker/): battery sensor for climate, inputs or motion that reports over LoRaWAN or to FIBER and is set up from a phone over NFC
- [EMBER](https://docs.hardwario.com/ember/): IP67 LoRaWAN gateway on the MikroTik platform, with ChirpStack or The Things Stack
- [FIBER](https://docs.hardwario.com/fiber/): embedded Linux device that reads 1-Wire probes and STICKER sensors over its own radio and sends the readings over MQTT; also FIBER Lite
- [GAUGER](https://docs.hardwario.com/gauger/): counts pulses on four galvanically separated inputs and serves the counts over Modbus TCP and a REST API
- [GLIDER](https://docs.hardwario.com/glider/): compact LTE-M and NB-IoT device built on the Nordic nRF9151
- [TAPPER](https://docs.hardwario.com/tapper/): NFC tag reader on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with the PN532 module
- [TOWER](https://docs.hardwario.com/tower/): modular IoT kit used for teaching (HARDWARIO Academy)
- [HARDWARIO Cloud](https://docs.hardwario.com/cloud/): receives CHESTER messages, updates firmware over the air and passes the data on through webhooks and a REST API
- [Applications](https://docs.hardwario.com/apps/): HARDWARIO Manager and integration guides for ChirpStack, The Things Stack and ThingsBoard
- [Smart devices](https://docs.hardwario.com/smart-devices/): supported third-party sensors, meters, gateways and industrial computers (Milesight, RAKwireless, MikroTik, Carlo Gavazzi, Nexelec, OnLogic, Raspberry Pi)
